answers.question: the object in the mirror are closer than it appears
gold_answers: The phrase `` objects in ( the ) mirror are closer than they appear '' is a safety warning that is required to be engraved on passenger side mirrors of motor vehicles in the USA , Canada , Nepal , India and Saudi Arabia . It is present because while these mirrors ' convexity gives them a useful field of view , it also makes objects appear smaller . Since smaller - appearing objects seem farther away than they actually are , a driver might make a maneuver such as a lane change assuming an adjacent vehicle is a safe distance behind , when in fact it is quite a bit closer . The warning serves as a reminder to the driver of this potential problem .
answers.model_answer: Yes.

answers.question: what were the technological developments of the old stone age
gold_answers: Stone tools were made from a variety of stones . For example , flint and chert were shaped ( or chipped ) for use as cutting tools and weapons , while basalt and sandstone were used for ground stone tools , such as quern - stones . Wood , bone , shell , antler ( deer ) and other materials were widely used , as well . During the most recent part of the period , sediments ( such as clay ) were used to make pottery . Agriculture was developed and certain animals were domesticated as well .
answers.model_answer: Stone-tool making, including Oldowan flakes and Acheulean handaxes and cleavers, and control of fire.
